name: @create-something/agency
description: Automation Design Firm — we apply the Subtractive Triad to design automation architectures that work

scripts.build: pnpm prepare:build-dir && pnpm prepare:local-deps && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs @sveltejs/kit svelte-kit sync && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs vite vite build
scripts.prepare: pnpm prepare:build-dir && pnpm prepare:local-deps && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs @sveltejs/kit svelte-kit sync || echo ''
scripts.copy:check: node ./scripts/check-public-copy.mjs && node --import tsx --test test/public-marketing-copy.test.ts test/field-report-evidence.test.ts test/product-family-contract.test.ts test/public-pricing-contract.test.ts test/integration-catalog.test.ts test/system-context-experience.test.ts test/playbook-hero-image-assets.test.ts
scripts.marketing:check: node --import tsx ./scripts/check-marketing-pages.mjs && node --import tsx --test test/marketing-pages.test.ts test/workflow-pages.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm prepare:build-dir && pnpm prepare:local-deps && pnpm integrations:check && pnpm search:campaign:check && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs @sveltejs/kit svelte-kit sync && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs svelte-check svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && pnpm canon:check && pnpm copy:check && node --import tsx --test test/community-api-auth.test.ts test/identity-provider-retirement.test.ts test/public-html-cache.test.ts && pnpm test:mcp-entitlement-authority && pnpm test:map-commercial-lifecycle && pnpm test:control-activation
scripts.search:campaign:check: node ./scripts/check-high-intent-search.mjs && node --import tsx --test test/high-intent-search.test.ts test/high-intent-search-attribution.test.ts && node --test test/high-intent-search-campaign.test.mjs
scripts.check:watch: pnpm prepare:build-dir && pnpm prepare:local-deps && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs @sveltejs/kit svelte-kit sync && node ./scripts/run-pinned-bin.mjs svelte-check svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings --watch
scripts.smoke:mobile: pnpm --filter @create-something/canon package && pnpm --filter @create-something/tufte package && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.mobile-smoke.config.ts
scripts.smoke:field-report-geometry: pnpm --filter @create-something/canon package && pnpm --filter @create-something/tufte package && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.field-report-geometry.config.ts
